I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092.

The number comes from Ilse's message in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, saying the ticket was open. Dana is a member of that channel, so they could already see it. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, and I passed that on in the reply.

I found no later update on the ticket anywhere Dana can see, and #help-it-ops is empty, so I can't confirm it's still open.
